svg.title: Wizard Duel pixel visual-effects library
svg.desc: Frame references and implementation rules for fireball, shield, lightning, dodge, hit, and casting effects.
svg.text: Fireball • shield • lightning • dodge smear • hit sparks • cast glyph • frame-by-frame timing
• Use nearest-neighbor scaling only; CSS image-rendering: pixelated.
• Never blur pixel VFX. Simulate glow with stacked pixel sprites / opacity layers.
• Projectile collision uses logical center; trail pixels are non-colliding.
• Impact frame is authored separately from travel loop.
• Keep VFX palette smaller than character palette so sprites remain readable.
• Recommended browser layer order: arena < characters < rune/VFX < HUD.
